name: Volza
summary: Export-import trade intelligence: search customs-level shipment records to find verified buyers and suppliers. Downloads run on a published credit allowance, from 360,000 full-shipment credits a year.
best_for: import-export businesses and sourcing teams that want global customs-level trade data plus verified buyer/supplier contacts at a fraction of enterprise pricing
skip_if: you only need US shipment data with fast daily updates (ImportGenius refreshes daily), or you're not doing import/export — this is a niche intelligence tool
honest_knock: Three honest catches. The entry plan is narrower than the marketing implies: $1,500 a year covers 182 countries and two users, while the 200-country coverage and ten seats start at $4,500. Downloads run on a credit allowance — 360,000 a year on Startup — and an earlier reading of the catalogue put the cost per record at one credit for US or India shipments and up to ten in thinner markets; that per-country rate is not stated on the current pricing page and we could not re-verify it on 1 September 2026, so treat it as a question for sales rather than a fact. And the update cycle is slow, with some datasets taking up to two months to refresh, which suits structural questions far better than reactive ones. There is a learning curve too; it rewards analysts, not casual users.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-23 on volza.com/pricing; first read 2026-09-01) Three paid annual plans and a free trial. Startup is $1,500 a year: 182 countries (44 export and 50 import detailed databases, 160 export and 158 import mirror databases, 7 export and 7 import one-side databases, premium countries excluded), data from 2014 onward, 6,000 searches, full shipment view, 360,000 full-shipment download credits and 2 users. SME is $4,500 a year: 200 countries, adds the statistical databases (46 export, 48 import), unlimited searches under fair use, 1,040,000 download credits and 10 users. Corporate is $9,600 a year: the same 200-country coverage, unlimited searches under fair use, 2,400,000 download credits and 15 users. The free trial runs 7 days with no card, is advertised as "$50 On sign up + Unlimited Volza credits", shows the last three years in full view with a six-month preview, and carries no full-shipment download credits. The 2-Year Value Plan is paid for the two years at once and advertised as 15% saving plus 15% bonus credits: Startup $2,550 (13,800 searches, 828,000 download credits, 5 users), SME $7,650 (2,392,000 credits, 10 users), Corporate $16,320 (5,520,000 credits, 15 users). The comparison table also caps workspaces at 75, 300 and 600 (Startup, SME, Corporate), workspace deletions at 20, 75 and 100 a month, and shipments per workspace at 300,000, 500,000 and 750,000; the free trial allows 10 users. The page also states a refund promise: if you find no profitable opportunity, Volza will help you find one or refund in full.
